title: Championship Entry – TCS London Marathon
claims: 2026 Championship places are capped at 1,200 (600 men, 600 women), selected fastest-first if applications exceed the cap; the application time must be achieved between 1 October 2024 and 30 September 2025.
Application times: marathon sub 2:38:00 men / sub 3:10:00 women; half marathon sub 1:11:30 men / sub 1:26:00 women.

Applicants must be registered members of a UK athletics body (England Athletics, Scotland Athletics, Welsh Athletics or Athletics Northern Ireland); non-UK residents who are UKA members may apply but are not eligible for the GFA fallback if unsuccessful.

A half-marathon time can only be used by runners who have never completed a marathon, or by runners whose marathon qualification time falls outside the qualifying window; falsification leads to a ban of up to five years, and a second breach to a life ban.
